notes: 2026-10-20 (Alex: no soldering at assembly): J4 was two wire pads for the speaker's leads; it is now J2's PicoBlade header, for INGHAi's GSPK151035PN speaker, whose leads end in a 1.25 mm 2-pin plug (datasheet: '35mm/1.25/2P').
Polarity: the amplifier is bridge-tied (FM8002A VO1/VO2), so the speaker's polarity only sets its acoustic phase. The speaker's red lead is its +; pin 1 is SPK_P (VO1). Neither pin may touch GND.
